-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/adep"

func main() { adep.Init() }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package adep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Init() uintptr {
	g := syscall.Syscall
	r, _, _ := g(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
	return r
}

-- c/main/go.mod --
module example.com/cmain

go 1.27

require example.com/cdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/cdep => ../dep

-- c/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- c/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/cdep"

func main() { cdep.Init() }

-- c/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/cdep

go 1.27

-- c/dep/dep.go --
package cdep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func apply(f func(trap, a1, a2, a3 uintptr) (uintptr, uintptr, syscall.Errno)) {
	f(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
}

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	apply(syscall.RawSyscall)
}

-- d/main/go.mod --
module example.com/dmain

go 1.27

-- d/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- d/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/dmain/lib"

func main() { lib.Init() }

-- d/main/lib/lib.go --
package lib

import "syscall"

var f = syscall.Syscall

//go:noinline
func apply(f func(trap, a1, a2, a3 uintptr) (uintptr, uintptr, syscall.Errno)) {
	f(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
}

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	g := syscall.Syscall
	g(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
	f(syscall.SYS_GETPID, 0, 0, 0)
	apply(syscall.RawSyscall)
}

go 1.27

-- k/dep/empty.s --
-- k/dep/dep.go --
package kdep

import "unsafe"

//go:linkname cgocall runtime.cgocall
func cgocall(fn, arg unsafe.Pointer) int32

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	cgocall(nil, nil)
}

-- n/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/ndep

go 1.27

-- n/dep/empty.s --
-- n/dep/dep.go --
package ndep

import (
	_ "syscall"
	_ "unsafe"
)

//go:linkname sys6 syscall.Syscall6
func sys6(trap, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6 uintptr) (r1, r2 uintptr, err uintptr)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	sys6(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
}
